sources: Structured after public records and published levels: the Environment Agency water quality archive and section 82 continuous river monitoring; event duration monitoring returns; English undertakers' published trade effluent charges schemes (the Mogden formula); the Water Environment (Water Framework Directive) (England and Wales) Directions 2015 for the ammonia standard; Metcalf and Eddy, Wastewater Engineering, fifth edition, for nitrification and oxygen levels; Carvalho, Prazeres and Rivas (2013) and Rocha-Mendoza and others (2021) for whey strength.
